I can do tombola setup and teardown tbf. know where the tables are kept in the hall, done it before 👍
lads I can do baking, a couple of trays of something easy 😄 no idea what yet tbh but I'll figure it out

I am free the 29th. Happy to take a role. Speaking as someone only recently able to commit to weekend events - appreciate being included. Y
I will attend. Please send any forms by the 20th.
